// diagnostic

E0915

Bare `{value}` on a type without `Display`

What

Bare `{value}` on a type without `Display`

Why

Bare interpolation shows a value through its `Display` implementation

Fix

Implement `Display` for the type or use an explicit formatter.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0915: tests/ui/E0915_fix_never_offers_a_failing_debug_hole.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingDisplay]: `Job` has no `Display` implementation
  --> tests/ui/E0915_fix_never_offers_a_failing_debug_hole.jet:9:21
    |
  9 |     print("running {job}")
    |                     ^^^
 Why: Bare `{value}` interpolation calls `Display` — there is no default for user types
 Fix: Add `impl Job.Display { display: fn(self) -> String { … } }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0915

Error [jet.ValueTypeMismatch]: `Job` can't be shown with :Debug yet
  --> tests/ui/E0915_fix_never_offers_a_failing_debug_hole.jet:10:19
    |
 10 |     print("debug {job:Debug}")
    |                   ^^^
 Why: Debug interpolation needs a debuggable value
 Fix: Implement `Debug` for `Job`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112
